The '''Modern Era''' was the name some scholars living around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] gave to the time they were living in. It seems to have specifically referred to the era following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]</ref>
